notes: Game Boy: hold the knob or swipe right from the left edge for the menu: RESUME, SAVE STATE, LOAD STATE, OVERLAY, PICTURE, QUIT
Game Boy: a button overlay over the game (OVERLAY, 0-100% opacity) shows the D-pad, A, B and SELECT zones
Game Boy: PICTURE fit (1.5x, whole picture inside the circle) or fill (2x, corners under the bezel)
Game Boy: faster -- small ROMs run from internal RAM and the core is built at -O2; the menu shows the machine's fps
